title: The capture box's button says "Capture" in every mode instead of what it does

source.ref: Toni House of Fates QA audit 2026-11-16 (project thread)

detail:
EVIDENCE: components/feed/capture-box.tsx passed submitLabel 'Capture' to the composer for every mode except a Space Dispatch, so writing a post, a poll, a question or a private note all ended on the same vague button. The composer's own default (components/feed/composer.tsx) already says Post or Save note; the box overrode it.

CLOSED 2026-11-16: the label now follows the mode: Post, Poll, Ask, Share and Photo say "Post", Note says "Save note", Dispatch says "Send Dispatch" (on a Space mount and on the member feed alike). No test or probe pinned the old label; the "Capture" in components/feed/capture-launcher.test.tsx is the nav trigger, not this button. Probe scripts/probes/capture-submit-label.mjs fails on the prior tree and passes here.
